Title: SMC IZS41-820P-06B IONIZER Incl VAT
Description:
Brand: SMC
PART NUMBER: IZS41-820P-06B
DESCRIPTION: IZS40/41/42, Ionizer
PROPERTIES/VALUES: Type: 41 (Feedback sensor type) Bar Length: 820mm Electrode Needle Material: High speed de-ionizing cartridge (Tungsten) Output: P (PNP) Power Supply Cable: 3m One-touch fitting: 06 Bracket: B (With bracket) Sensor: Built-in Sensor Option: None
LONG DESCRIPTION: We are delighted to unveil a trio of new ionizers in our IZS Series that are responding to customer demand for faster and more efficient static charge neutralising solutions. All three models feature the AC type ion discharge, with the most basic model capable of deionizing in just 3.2 seconds at 1,000mm with a simple ON/OFF function. The high speed model rapidly removes static electricity with its feedback sensor and selectable energy saving or continuous neutralization run modes makes it flexible too. Alternatively, the dual AC type model reduces both the potential amplitude by 25V or less and the amount of ion given to the work-piece, allowing for close installation in the electronic device and semiconductor industry. This series incorporates two auto balance sensors, one within the body of the ionizer as standard and an optional high accuracy external sensor. A wireless remote control allows operators to adjust and set up to 16 ionizers remotely from 5m away as well as easy and quick serial wiring thanks to link cable connectors, joining up to eight units. LONG DESCRIPTION: The IZN10E is SMC's nozzle ionizer.  The nozzle ionizer emits an air-assisted cone of static eliminating ions for focused targets 2 inches or smaller, up to 20 inches away.  The nozzle can be used with an optional sensor and monitor to suspend emission when static elimination is complete, or when the target is not present.  Available with a high flow or enery saving nozzle, or female threads to attach an accessory.  The cartridge can be removed without tools for needle cleaning or replacement.  Slim, compact design is suitable for installation in tight spaces.
BULLET POINTS: Slim & Lightweight. Offset voltage: ±10V. Nozzle variations. With external switch input function (2 inputs). Easy maintenance. Intermittent control timer.

Description:
Brand: SMC
PART NUMBER: IZS40-1120-06B
DESCRIPTION: IZS40/41/42, Ionizer
PROPERTIES/VALUES: Type: 40 (Standard type) Bar Length: 1120mm Electrode Needle Material: High speed de-ionizing cartridge (Tungsten) Output: NPN (or none for type 40) Power Supply Cable: 3m One-touch fitting: 06 Bracket: B (With bracket) Sensor: Built-in Sensor Option: None
LONG DESCRIPTION: We are delighted to unveil a trio of new ionizers in our IZS Series that are responding to customer demand for faster and more efficient static charge neutralising solutions. All three models feature the AC type ion discharge, with the most basic model capable of deionizing in just 3.2 seconds at 1,000mm with a simple ON/OFF function. The high speed model rapidly removes static electricity with its feedback sensor and selectable energy saving or continuous neutralization run modes makes it flexible too. Alternatively, the dual AC type model reduces both the potential amplitude by 25V or less and the amount of ion given to the work-piece, allowing for close installation in the electronic device and semiconductor industry. This series incorporates two auto balance sensors, one within the body of the ionizer as standard and an optional high accuracy external sensor. A wireless remote control allows operators to adjust and set up to 16 ionizers remotely from 5m away as well as easy and quick serial wiring thanks to link cable connectors, joining up to eight units. The IZS ionizers are suitable for several applications within a range of industries such as PET bottle manufacturing, parts feeders, resin and rubber moulding, food and beverage packaging, film and paper manufacturing and wafer transfers, delivering safer manufacturing processes, reducing production mistakes and the derivative non-quality costs.
BULLET POINTS: IZS40: Basic type (AC, DC) / IZS41: High speed (AC, Sensing AC, DC) / IZS42: Dual AC type. Controller integrated in the bar. Autobalance sensor, feedback sensor. Wireless remote control. Transition wiring for ionizers serial connection. Display and warning alarms.

LONG DESCRIPTION: We are delighted to unveil a trio of new ionizers in our IZS Series that are responding to customer demand for faster and more efficient static charge neutralising solutions. All three models feature the AC type ion discharge, with the most basic model capable of deionizing in just 3.2 seconds at 1,000mm with a simple ON/OFF function. The high speed model rapidly removes static electricity with its feedback sensor and selectable energy saving or continuous neutralization run modes makes it flexible too. Alternatively, the dual AC type model reduces both the potential amplitude by 25V or less and the amount of ion given to the work-piece, allowing for close installation in the electronic device and semiconductor industry. This series incorporates two auto balance sensors, one within the body of the ionizer as standard and an optional high accuracy external sensor. A wireless remote control allows operators to adjust and set up to 16 ionizers remotely from 5m away as well as easy and quick serial wiring thanks to link cable connectors, joining up to eight units. The IZS ionizers are suitable for several applications within a range of industries such as PET bottle manufacturing, parts feeders, resin and rubber moulding, food and beverage packaging, film and paper manufacturing and wafer transfers, delivering safer manufacturing processes, reducing production mistakes and the derivative non-quality costs.
BULLET POINTS: IZS40: Basic type (AC, DC) / IZS41: High speed (AC, Sensing AC, DC) / IZS42: Dual AC type. Controller integrated in the bar. Autobalance sensor, feedback sensor. Wireless remote control. Transition wiring for ionizers serial connection. Display and warning alarms.

Description:
Brand: SMC

DESCRIPTION: IZS40/41/42, Ionizer
PROPERTIES/VALUES: Type: 40 (Standard type) Bar Length: 460mm Electrode Needle Material: High speed de-ionizing cartridge (Tungsten) Output: NPN (or none for type 40) Power Supply Cable: 3m One-touch fitting: 06 Bracket: B (With bracket) Sensor: Built-in Sensor Option: None
LONG DESCRIPTION: We are delighted to unveil a trio of new ionizers in our IZS Series that are responding to customer demand for faster and more efficient static charge neutralising solutions. All three models feature the AC type ion discharge, with the most basic model capable of deionizing in just 3.2 seconds at 1,000mm with a simple ON/OFF function. The high speed model rapidly removes static electricity with its feedback sensor and selectable energy saving or continuous neutralization run modes makes it flexible too. Alternatively, the dual AC type model reduces both the potential amplitude by 25V or less and the amount of ion given to the work-piece, allowing for close installation in the electronic device and semiconductor industry. This series incorporates two auto balance sensors, one within the body of the ionizer as standard and an optional high accuracy external sensor. A wireless remote control allows operators to adjust and set up to 16 ionizers remotely from 5m away as well as easy and quick serial wiring thanks to link cable connectors, joining up to eight units. The IZS ionizers are suitable for several applications within a range of industries such as PET bottle manufacturing, parts feeders, resin and rubber moulding, food and beverage packaging, film and paper manufacturing and wafer transfers, delivering safer manufacturing processes, reducing production mistakes and the derivative non-quality costs.
BULLET POINTS: IZS40: Basic type (AC, DC) / IZS41: High speed (AC, Sensing AC, DC) / IZS42: Dual AC type. Controller integrated in the bar. Autobalance sensor, feedback sensor. Wireless remote control. Transition wiring for ionizers serial connection. Display and warning alarms.

Title: SMC IZS41-1120P-06B IONIZER Incl VAT
Description:
Brand: SMC
PART NUMBER: IZS41-1120P-06B
DESCRIPTION: IZS40/41/42, Ionizer
PROPERTIES/VALUES: Type: 41 (Feedback sensor type) Bar Length: 1120mm Electrode Needle Material: High speed de-ionizing cartridge (Tungsten) Output: P (PNP) Power Supply Cable: 3m One-touch fitting: 06 Bracket: B (With bracket) Sensor: Built-in Sensor Option: None
LONG DESCRIPTION: We are delighted to unveil a trio of new ionizers in our IZS Series that are responding to customer demand for faster and more efficient static charge neutralising solutions. All three models feature the AC type ion discharge, with the most basic model capable of deionizing in just 3.2 seconds at 1,000mm with a simple ON/OFF function. The high speed model rapidly removes static electricity with its feedback sensor and selectable energy saving or continuous neutralization run modes makes it flexible too. Alternatively, the dual AC type model reduces both the potential amplitude by 25V or less and the amount of ion given to the work-piece, allowing for close installation in the electronic device and semiconductor industry. This series incorporates two auto balance sensors, one within the body of the ionizer as standard and an optional high accuracy external sensor. A wireless remote control allows operators to adjust and set up to 16 ionizers remotely from 5m away as well as easy and quick serial wiring thanks to link cable connectors, joining up to eight units. The IZS ionizers are suitable for several applications within a range of industries such as PET bottle manufacturing, parts feeders, resin and rubber moulding, food and beverage packaging, film and paper manufacturing and wafer transfers, delivering safer manufacturing processes, reducing production mistakes and the derivative non-quality costs.
BULLET POINTS: IZS40: Basic type (AC, DC) / IZS41: High speed (AC, Sensing AC, DC) / IZS42: Dual AC type. Controller integrated in the bar. Autobalance sensor, feedback sensor. Wireless remote control. Transition wiring for ionizers serial connection. Display and warning alarms.

DESCRIPTION: IZS40/41/42, Ionizer
PROPERTIES/VALUES: Type: 41 (Feedback sensor type) Bar Length: 460mm Electrode Needle Material: High speed de-ionizing cartridge (Tungsten) Output: P (PNP) Power Supply Cable: 3m One-touch fitting: 06 Bracket: B (With bracket) Sensor: Built-in Sensor Option: None
LONG DESCRIPTION: We are delighted to unveil a trio of new ionizers in our IZS Series that are responding to customer demand for faster and more efficient static charge neutralising solutions. All three models feature the AC type ion discharge, with the most basic model capable of deionizing in just 3.2 seconds at 1,000mm with a simple ON/OFF function. The high speed model rapidly removes static electricity with its feedback sensor and selectable energy saving or continuous neutralization run modes makes it flexible too. Alternatively, the dual AC type model reduces both the potential amplitude by 25V or less and the amount of ion given to the work-piece, allowing for close installation in the electronic device and semiconductor industry. This series incorporates two auto balance sensors, one within the body of the ionizer as standard and an optional high accuracy external sensor. A wireless remote control allows operators to adjust and set up to 16 ionizers remotely from 5m away as well as easy and quick serial wiring thanks to link cable connectors, joining up to eight units. The IZS ionizers are suitable for several applications within a range of industries such as PET bottle manufacturing, parts feeders, resin and rubber moulding, food and beverage packaging, film and paper manufacturing and wafer transfers, delivering safer manufacturing processes, reducing production mistakes and the derivative non-quality costs.
BULLET POINTS: IZS40: Basic type (AC, DC) / IZS41: High speed (AC, Sensing AC, DC) / IZS42: Dual AC type. Controller integrated in the bar. Autobalance sensor, feedback sensor. Wireless remote control. Transition wiring for ionizers serial connection. Display and warning alarms.

Title: SMC IZT43-D36HP-3FU 02144949 Incl VAT
Description:
Brand: SMC
PART NUMBER: IZT43-D36HP-3FU
DESCRIPTION: IZT43, Nozzle Type Ionizer, Separate Controller and Power Supply Module
PROPERTIES/VALUES: Emitter Cartridge Type: D (High Speed Static Neutralization Cartridge) High Voltage Cable Length: 3 (3m) One-touch fitting: 6H (diameter 6 Straight) Input/Output: P (PNP) Power Supply Cable Length: 3 (3m) Nozzle Bracket: F (Angle Adjustment Bracket) DIN Rail Mounting Bracket: U (Controller Supply Module: Included)
LONG DESCRIPTION: The IZT43 nozzle ionizer combines a compact emitter head with separate controller and power supply modules to enable static control treatment in spaces with limited clearance.  When an air supply is connected to the built-in fitting, the nozzle can project a cone of static eliminating ions toward a target up to 2000mm/6.5 ft away.  The application of treatment from a single nozzle saves expensive compressed air compared to a multi-emitter bar, ideal for smaller targets.  Static removal is also possible at a closer distance with no air supply.  The nozzle can be located up to 3m/9.8 ft from the controller, for remote settings and monitoring at the operator's workstation.  Control parameters include AC or DC ion emission mode, ion generation frequency, and offset voltage adjustment.  Feedback includes an adjustable emitter contamination alarm, 10 operational alarms, frequency and balance displays, and channel indicator.  Setup keys can be locked for security.  Ion generation can be stopped via input signal.  Extending the value of IZT43, one controller can manage a maximum of 4 ionizing nozzles.  Separation cables of up to 3m/9.8 ft allow a flexible layout of power supplies for a multi-nozzle installation.  IZT nozzles and bars can be combined for further flexibility.  Emitter cartridges are easily removed without tools, for cleaning or end-of-life replacement.  Individual cables and nozzle bodies are also available as spare parts to replace if damaged.
BULLET POINTS: Separate controller nozzle-type ionizer Compact: Height 32 mm x Width 16 mm IZTC41 controller can control a maximum of 4 ionizers Monitor and operate nozzles which are installed in an inaccessible location Multiple alarms & functions Static elimination with no air supply.

LONG DESCRIPTION: The IZT43 nozzle ionizer combines a compact emitter head with separate controller and power supply modules to enable static control treatment in spaces with limited clearance.  When an air supply is connected to the built-in fitting, the nozzle can project a cone of static eliminating ions toward a target up to 2000mm/6.5 ft away.  The application of treatment from a single nozzle saves expensive compressed air compared to a multi-emitter bar, ideal for smaller targets.  Static removal is also possible at a closer distance with no air supply.  The nozzle can be located up to 3m/9.8 ft from the controller, for remote settings and monitoring at the operator's workstation.  Control parameters include AC or DC ion emission mode, ion generation frequency, and offset voltage adjustment.  Feedback includes an adjustable emitter contamination alarm, 10 operational alarms, frequency and balance displays, and channel indicator.  Setup keys can be locked for security.  Ion generation can be stopped via input signal.  Extending the value of IZT43, one controller can manage a maximum of 4 ionizing nozzles.  Separation cables of up to 3m/9.8 ft allow a flexible layout of power supplies for a multi-nozzle installation.  IZT nozzles and bars can be combined for further flexibility.  Emitter cartridges are easily removed without tools, for cleaning or end-of-life replacement.  Individual cables and nozzle bodies are also available as spare parts to replace if damaged.

Title: SMC JC20-8-125 FLOATING JOINT Incl VAT
Description:
Brand: SMC
PART NUMBER: JC20-8-125
DESCRIPTION: JC, Floating Joint, Standard, Light Weight Type
PROPERTIES/VALUES: Bore Size: diameter 20 Nominal Thread: M8 x 1.25
LONG DESCRIPTION: We are delighted to announce the arrival of the JC Series, a lightweight floating joint to complement our existing range for pneumatic cylinders. A key feature is the JC's aluminium case which offers up to 30% reduction in weight, reducing the inertial forces and lateral loads to actuators whilst operational. The joint is also protected by a dustproof cover, extending its operating life. With a rotating angle of ±5° and allowable eccentricity of ±0.5 to 1mm, the JC is designed to compensate for any misalignment that may occur between the workpiece and the cylinder. This deviation absorption capacity reduces the wear of the cylinders, extending their service time. It can operate at a maximum tensile/compressive force of 3100N for cylinder bore sizes ranging from 20 to 63mm and with thread sizes from M8x1.25 to M18x1.5. The JC Series is ideal for any pneumatic cylinder where the joint needs to absorb off-centring or loss of parallel accuracy between the cylinder and the driven body.

The JC Series is ideal for any pneumatic cylinder where the joint needs to absorb off-centring or loss of parallel accuracy between the cylinder and the driven body.

Title: SMC JC40-14-150 FLOATING JOINT Incl VAT
Description:
Brand: SMC
PART NUMBER: JC40-14-150
DESCRIPTION: JC, Floating Joint, Standard, Light Weight Type
PROPERTIES/VALUES: Bore Size: diameter 40 Nominal Thread: M14 x 1.5
LONG DESCRIPTION: We are delighted to announce the arrival of the JC Series, a lightweight floating joint to complement our existing range for pneumatic cylinders. A key feature is the JC's aluminium case which offers up to 30% reduction in weight, reducing the inertial forces and lateral loads to actuators whilst operational. The joint is also protected by a dustproof cover, extending its operating life. With a rotating angle of ±5° and allowable eccentricity of ±0.5 to 1mm, the JC is designed to compensate for any misalignment that may occur between the workpiece and the cylinder. This deviation absorption capacity reduces the wear of the cylinders, extending their service time. It can operate at a maximum tensile/compressive force of 3100N for cylinder bore sizes ranging from 20 to 63mm and with thread sizes from M8x1.25 to M18x1.5. The JC Series is ideal for any pneumatic cylinder where the joint needs to absorb off-centring or loss of parallel accuracy between the cylinder and the driven body.
BULLET POINTS: Standard/Thread nominal size.

With the backflow function it incorporates a mechanism to exhaust the air pressure in the outlet side reliably and quickly.
BULLET POINTS: Modular type filter regulator. Transparent bowl guard. Available with built-in backflow mechanism. Rc, G(PF) or NPT threads.
